pos.personaBrief: Napoli led Serie A in passes (642 per game) and dictated play through Jorginho, with vertical combinations from a 4-3-3; possession is the base of control, not a counter-attacking trap.

pro.personaBrief: Short build-up from the goalkeeper and centre-backs, baiting the press, then a constant search for the forward pass and quick vertical progression; Jorginho breaks lines. Long balls only occasionally, through the middle to players between the lines.

est.personaBrief: Triangles, one-twos and third-man runs, with rotations on the left (Hamsik, Ghoulam, Insigne) and players moving off set positions, though built on rehearsed automatisms.

lar.personaBrief: Few crosses and play through the centre with wingers (Insigne, Callejon, Mertens) drifting inside while full-backs give the width; the left combines in tight space.

blo.personaBrief: High defensive line, aggressive press from the striker onward, counter-press regains and four men around the ball.

mar.personaBrief: Zonal, space-oriented collective defending with half-and-half positions and cover shadows; the Spielverlagerung piece contrasts it with Juve's man-oriented approach. Zonal corner defence is assumed, not verified.

pla.personaBrief: The same 4-3-3 model and the usual eleven were kept against every opponent, with only small pressing tweaks such as Mertens' role against Juventus.

res.personaBrief: An expansive, attacking style, 251 league goals, and an insistence on playing on the ground; the aim is to win through the game itself, and he does not shut down matches or settle for draws.

sis.personaBrief: The system and its automatisms make players such as Albiol, Hysaj and Mertens (converted to striker) better; everyone has defensive duties and a defined role, and the style rests on collective discipline.

jog.personaBrief: He built the team around the technical Jorginho and used goalkeepers and centre-backs comfortable on the ball; technique and speed of thought come first, though pressing demands intensity.

bas.personaBrief: He worked with a fixed core of senior players (Reina, Albiol, Hamsik, Callejon) and signings, with no youth-academy emphasis; the same eleven won points and he valued experienced players.

lid.personaBrief: He is a direct, honest coach with the final word on the line-up (Insigne benched) and equal rules, while building a strong team ethic; the focus is on the method rather than managing feelings.
